stemMd: A printer produces 18 labels per minute. At that constant rate, how many labels does it produce in 2 hours 20 minutes?
explanationMd: Two hours twenty minutes is 140 minutes. Multiplying the rate 18 labels per minute by 140 minutes gives 2,520 labels.

distractorRationale.b: This counts only the two full hours.
distractorRationale.a: This treats the rate as three labels per minute or miscombines the units.
distractorRationale.c: This does not convert the additional twenty minutes correctly.
